input.free_text_description: This system is a content management platform that serves Content Creator, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for embedded, simple, i simple. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Content Creator, I want to interact with simple functionality, so that I can accomplish my simple-related tasks.
As a Content Creator, I want to interact with test functionality, so that I can accomplish my test-related tasks.
As a Content Creator, I want to interact with exception advice functionality, so that I can accomplish my exception advice-related tasks.
As a Content Creator, I want to use embedded capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
